children: President Donald Trump is canvassing the Truth Social community to come up with a more "elegant and accurate" description of machine intelligence.
Trump posted urging a vote for the best new name for the ever-growing AI "revolution."
His three choices of Superior Intelligence, Extreme Intelligence and Supreme Intelligence would seem to be a nod to the ascendency of AI, even as he reiterated that fears of AI
Current tally (only registered Truth Social users can vote):
The winner could be used for the name of Trump's proposed AI Force and AI Czar.

"Many people think that the words 'Artificial Intelligence' are inaccurate, and very ineloquent, relative to AI, or Artificial Intelligence. A far more elegant and accurate description of this new phenomena would be Superior Intelligence
or, Extreme Intelligence (EI) or, Supreme Intelligence
. This is a Poll, and I would appreciate everybody voting! Which is the best name for this ever growing 'Revolution?'"
